A whitespace-only inline element contributes exactly one space

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>A<i> </i>B</p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
